decisions.reason: Building on the established crewing offer keeps uncertainty and keeping costs low, so the option remains worth holding.
The early quantified progress with six partner institutions suggests value is emerging, but the programme is still young enough to keep as a low-cost real option.
Its close fit with core services and demonstrated compliance success make abandonment unlikely.
The dashboard is a low-cost digital add-on to the established PAL software, so its option value justifies keeping it while adoption remains uncertain.
The simulator is likewise a low-cost integrated tool, and although its standalone value is uncertain, it is not costly enough to drop yet.
